title: GDPR articles, explained
lede: A quick reference to the articles discussed in the foundations chapter, grouped by theme: principles, rights, protection, lawful processing, transfers, and remedies.

items.label: Article 5.1.a
items.title: Lawfulness, Fairness and Transparency
items.text: Ensures data is processed lawfully, fairly and transparently

items.label: Article 5.1.b
items.title: Purpose Limitation
items.text: Data must be collected for specified, explicit purposes

items.label: Article 5.1.c
items.title: Data Minimisation
items.text: Only data necessary for the purpose should be processed

items.label: Article 5.1.d
items.title: Accuracy
items.text: Personal data must be accurate and kept up to date

items.label: Article 5.1.e
items.title: Storage Limitation
items.text: Keep data no longer than necessary

items.label: Article 5.1.f
items.title: Integrity and Confidentiality
items.text: Ensure security and confidentiality of personal data

items.label: Article 5.2
items.title: Accountability
items.text: Controllers are responsible for GDPR compliance

items.label: Article 15
items.title: Right to Access
items.text: Right to access personal data

items.label: Article 16
items.title: Right to Rectification
items.text: Right to rectify inaccurate data

items.label: Article 17
items.title: Right to Erasure
items.text: Right to erasure (right to be forgotten)

items.label: Article 18
items.title: Right to Restriction
items.text: Right to restrict processing

items.label: Article 20
items.title: Right to Data Portability
items.text: Right to data portability

items.label: Article 21
items.title: Right to Object
items.text: Right to object to processing

items.label: Article 25
items.title: Privacy by Design and Default
items.text: Data protection must be embedded into system design

items.label: Article 32
items.title: Security of Processing
items.text: Requires appropriate technical and organizational security

items.label: Article 33
items.title: Breach Notification to Authority
items.text: Notify authority within 72 hours of data breach

items.label: Article 34
items.title: Breach Notification to Individuals
items.text: Inform affected individuals of data breach if high risk

items.label: Article 35
items.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
items.text: Required for high-risk processing operations

items.label: Article 6
items.title: Lawful Basis
items.text: Lists lawful bases for processing personal data

items.label: Article 7
items.title: Conditions for Consent
items.text: Conditions for valid consent

items.label: Article 8
items.title: Children's Consent
items.text: Consent rules for children's data

items.label: Article 9
items.title: Sensitive Data
items.text: Prohibits processing of sensitive data unless exceptions apply

items.title: General Principles
items.text: General principles for international data transfers

items.label: Article 45
items.title: Adequacy Decisions
items.text: Transfers based on adequacy decisions

items.label: Article 46

items.text: Transfers with appropriate safeguards

items.title: Derogations
items.text: Derogations for specific situations
